title: Taxonomy Editor Runtime Configuration
description: Optional runtime config (t/905). Every field has a hardcoded default; a missing file or absent section falls back to defaults. Location: {dataRoot}/admin/runtime-config.json.

$schema.description: Path to this schema for editor tooling.

_meta.description: Audit metadata. Updated by the admin UI / PowerShell cmdlets on write.

version.description: Schema version. Must equal 1; a non-1 file is rejected and defaults are used.

updatedAt.description: ISO timestamp of the last write.

updatedBy.description: Principal that last wrote the config.

resilience.description: Client network resilience (circuit breaker, retry, adaptive throttle). Delivered to the renderer via GET /api/config/client.

circuitThreshold.description: Consecutive failures before the circuit opens. Default 5.

circuitCooldownMs.description: How long the circuit stays open before half-open probe (ms). Default 60000.

retryJitterMaxMs.description: Max random jitter added to each retry (ms). Default 500.

maxRetryAfterMs.description: Cap honored from a server Retry-After header (ms). Default 30000.

throttleWindowSize.description: Rolling window of recent requests for adaptive throttle. Default 20.

throttleBaselineCount.description: Baseline request count used to compute throttle factors. Default 10.

throttleEnterFactor.description: Load factor at which throttling engages. Must exceed throttleExitFactor. Default 2.0.

throttleExitFactor.description: Load factor at which throttling disengages. Must be < throttleEnterFactor. Default 1.5.

throttleDelayMs.description: Delay injected per request while throttled (ms). Default 2000.

cleanupCutoffMs.description: Idle age after which a limiter bucket is evicted (ms). Default 120000.

tiers.description: Default per-tier limits. Per-user overrides remain in proxy-tiers.json.

pinnedModel.description: Model the free tier is pinned to. Default 'gemini-flash-lite-latest'.

quotas.description: Default per-user content quotas. Per-user overrides remain in quotas.json.

defaultMaxChats.description: Max saved chats per user. Default 25.

defaultMaxDebates.description: Max saved debates per user. Default 15.

defaultMaxOpEds.description: Max saved op-ed sets per user. Default 15.

sessions.description: Anonymous session store and session-branch locking.

anonymousMaxSizeBytes.description: Max bytes stored per anonymous session. Default 10485760 (10 MB).

tokenFreshnessThresholdMs.description: Age at which a cached token is refreshed (ms). Default 60000.

lockAcquireTimeoutMs.description: Max wait to acquire a session-branch lock (ms). Default 10000.

lockHoldTtlMs.description: Auto-release TTL for a held session-branch lock (ms). Default 30000.

retentionDays.description: Days analytics events are retained. Default 90.

bufferRequeueLimit.description: Max client-buffered events requeued after a failed flush. Default 500.

flightRecorder.description: Flight recorder dump throttling and retention.

maxRetainedDumps.description: Max dump pairs retained on disk. Default 20.

maxPendingPerUser.description: Max pending submissions per user. Default 20.

globalPendingCap.description: Max pending submissions across all users. Default 500.

gitCloneTimeoutMs.description: Git clone timeout (ms, max 1h). Default 300000 (5 min).

gitFetchTimeoutMs.description: Git fetch timeout (ms, max 1h). Default 600000 (10 min).

gitDefaultTimeoutMs.description: Default git op timeout (ms, max 1h). Default 120000 (2 min).

gitBufferLimitBytes.description: Max git subprocess stdout buffer (bytes). Default 10485760 (10 MB).

apiKeyMaskLength.description: Visible characters when masking an API key in logs/UI. Default 4.

pollGate.description: The t/4251 renderer poll gate's live switch, delivered via GET /api/config/client. Default false (no behavior change — background/idle tabs keep polling). Turning it on is a TL/PI decision gated on t/4258 acceptance criterion 2 (overlay-write durability).

enabled.description: Switches the t/4251 renderer poll gate on. Default false.

debate.description: Per-phase debate parameters (round limits, stage temperatures, token limits, timeouts).

defaultTemperature.description: Default debate temperature (user-facing slider default). Default 0.7.

summarizationMaxTokens.description: Max tokens for summarization output. Default 500.

evaluatorMaxTokens.description: Max tokens for evaluator output. Default 8192.

maxRegenAttempts.description: Max regeneration attempts per turn. Default 3.
